title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Foreclosure Charge Carry for Retention Payoffs
content:
# Foreclosure charge carry — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the foreclosure charge carry enters the retention accrual basis. It follows the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product: its status and its referral date.

The foreclosure charge carry is USD 2525.00, the full foreclosure charges, when the maturity case's status is referred to foreclosure and its referral date is at least 30 calendar days before the statement date; it is USD 875.00, the initial foreclosure charges, when its status is referred to foreclosure and it was referred fewer days before, a case with no referral date counting as referred 0 days before; a case in any other status carries nothing (0.00).

## Boundary table

| Maturity case on the statement date | Foreclosure charge carry |
|---|---|
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 30 or more days before | USD 2525.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 29 days before | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure on the statement date itself (0 days) | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, no referral date recorded | USD 875.00 |
| Due and payable, or in its extension period | nothing |

The 30-day mark is reached on the 30th calendar day after the referral date: a referral dated exactly 30 days before the statement date takes USD 2525.00.
